items.title: Bounties: named topics an agent can be primed on in one call
items.evidence: ### Problem Memory is grouped under scopes that are bare ids with counts. Journal entries have no scope. An agent that has to continue another agent's work on a topic has no single way to load that topic: it must guess a scope id, run several recalls and search an unscoped journal. ### Outcome A user names a topic in conversation. Any agent on any client finds it, loads it in one call and continues the work. Topics never open or close; they accumulate knowledge and are updated as things change. "Bounty" is the product word for such a topic. ###

items.title: Spec: a demo vault the drain bot can't empty (ADR-0019)
items.evidence: Part of #35 · Decision: ADR-0019 · Amends ADR-0018 ## Problem Statement On Nov 7 the first mainnet run's demo vaults were drained 4 s (Base) and 8 s (Arbitrum) after funding, before any claim, by a general-purpose drain bot active on both chains since Sep 23. The demo vault's bug, a missing access check, is one call deep, so any bot that simulates calls finds it. A demo bounty whose funds a bot takes first can't be won by the AI agent, so the mainnet demo (ADR-0018: one bounty, won by an AI agent with a claim key) can't happen with that vault.

items.evidence: ### Summary `hyb check` accepts values whose **composite** type differs from the target only in its integer/float element type: `[]i64` → `[]int`, `[2]i64` → `[2]int`, `map[string]i64` → `map[string]int`, `*i64` → `*int`. That happens in `var` declarations, plain assignment, call arguments and `return`. In Go, composite types are assignable only when they are identical, so `go build` rejects every case (GUARANTEES.md Row 13 BUILDABLE). items.title: parse_duration ignores uppercase units and returns 0 for invalid input
items.evidence: `parse_duration` in `src/duration.py` returns the wrong value for uppercase units: `parse_duration("1H30M")` returns 0 instead of 5400. Both cases are reproduced by `tests/test_duration.py`, which fails on the current tree with 2 failures. items.evidence: `page_bounds` in `src/pagination.py` drops the last item of every full page.
